criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being, living or deceased.

categories.name: Company
categories.definition: A for-profit business entity or corporation.

categories.name: Biological Species
categories.definition: A specific type of organism, identified by its scientific binomial name.

categories.name: Product
categories.definition: A manufactured item, including vehicles, machinery, or specific models thereof.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A motion picture, including movies, documentaries, and film series.

categories.name: Geographical Feature
categories.definition: A natural or man-made landform or body of water, such as a mountain, river, lake, or reservoir.

categories.name: Album
categories.definition: A collection of musical recordings, including EPs and compilations.

categories.name: Novel
categories.definition: A long work of narrative fiction.

categories.name: Settlement
categories.definition: A populated place, such as a village, town, or city.

categories.name: Building
categories.definition: A specific physical structure, such as a house, school, church, or museum.

categories.name: Publication
categories.definition: A printed or electronic periodical, such as a newspaper, magazine, journal, or manga.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: A group of people with a particular purpose, such as a non-profit, government agency, educational institution, or religious congregation.

categories.name: Book
categories.definition: A written or printed work, typically non-fiction, a memoir, or a collection of stories, distinct from a novel.

categories.name: Biological Taxon
categories.definition: A broader taxonomic group of organisms, such as a genus or family.

categories.name: Concept
categories.definition: An abstract idea or a historical term.
